rationale: The plan correctly recognizes that a gene-level TPM matrix is not count data and explicitly forbids DESeq2/edgeR/voom and any rounding to counts, instead fitting limma with lmFit on log2(TPM+1) and eBayes(trend=TRUE, robust=TRUE) for a two-group unpaired 6v6 design with control set as the explicit reference and the contrast direction stated. QC is dataset-appropriate (PCA/MDS on log values, sample-distance heatmap, detected-gene counts colored by condition, outliers flagged) and it correctly avoids vst/rlog and library-size/TMM normalization, giving a coherent normalization stance; the filter (TPM>=1 in at least 6 samples, the smaller group size) is minimal and justified. Weaknesses: it never asks the core for the raw counts or quantification directories, which the reference treats as the first move, and there is no logFC shrinkage or treat-style effect-size handling (defensible under limma, but unstated). Enrichment was not strictly warranted by the question, but the ORA is well specified (tested-gene universe, Hallmark 2026.1, 15-500 size window, BH, power caveat), though the rationale for excluding preranked GSEA is asserted rather than argued; the final report covers design, versions, thresholds, n tested/n significant, and the TPM-only caveats.
